messages:
olivia: Hey folks, opened a micro-PR to explain the "cooldown hysteresis" we added to Dedicated scale_policy. It confused a couple of customers in the field. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1599

olivia: Ask: add a tiny diagram sentence, a compact YAML + SDK sample showing `grace_window_seconds` interacting with `cooldown_seconds`, and a translator note for the new "grace window" term.

arjun: good call. for the diagram sentence, how about: "grace_window_seconds delays eviction decisions to allow short spikes to resolve during scale-up." Short and actionable.

pat: dropping the YAML i'd like to include:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  cooldown_seconds: 90
  grace_window_seconds: 30
  queue_limit: 400
  fallback_policy: "reserved-pool-fallback"
```

pat: and a one-liner explanation to accompany it: "During a transient spike, requests above queue_limit are queued during the grace window; if saturation persists past grace_window_seconds + cooldown_seconds, fallback policies (including preemption/eviction) are considered."

mika: prefer we avoid implying eviction is instantaneous after that period. Suggest: "... are considered and may be triggered per tenant-priority and fallback settings."

arjun: +1. also add a short timeline example for readability: "example timeline: t0 request spike -> t0..t0+30s queued (grace) -> autoscaler scales during cooldown -> if still saturated by t0+120s, fallback evaluation runs."

olivia: nice. we also need an SDK sample (python) that mirrors YAML shape and mentions field aliases in the client.

pat: SDK snippet for PR body:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
policy = dict(
  mode="autoscale",
  cooldown_seconds=90,
  grace_window_seconds=30,
  queue_limit=400,
  fallback_policy="reserved-pool-fallback",
)
client.set_scale_policy(tenant_id="acct-202", policy=policy)
```

pat: note in PR: SDK accepts `cooldown_sec` as legacy alias; client will log deprecation warning.

olivia: i18n-bot: please add one-line translator context for "grace window": // context: temporary buffer time to avoid evicting during short bursts.

i18n-bot: added suggested context string to PR comment.

docs-ci: linkcheck: found one broken internal anchor -> #eviction-timeline (line 62)

olivia: thanks CI. i'll update that link to #fallback-evaluation-timeline.

mika: editorial note: change the SLA phrasing from "eviction after X" to "fallback evaluation may lead to eviction depending on configured priorities and policy". keeps the language non-guarantee.

arjun: added a short error payload example for callers (also showing `retry_after_ms`):
```json
{
  "error": "tenant_queue_overflow",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_ms": 45000,
  "advice": "backoff_or_route_to_alternate_region"
}
```

pat: small infra sync: ensure `reserved-pool-fallback` matches catalog name (infra uses `reserved_pool_fallback` with underscore). i'll open a tiny infra issue to reconcile or add a docs note.

olivia: plan: pat will reconcile fallback name with infra, arjun will add timeline sentence and soften eviction wording, mika will do copyedit, i18n-bot added translator context. i'll merge after linkcheck green and infra confirmation. target: tomorrow lunchtime. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

arjun: thanks all 44d
